stem.text: An autocatalytic reaction is a reaction in which one of the products catalyses the reaction.
Which curve would be obtained if the rate of an autocatalytic reaction is plotted against time?

A.alt: Graph of rate against time: rate rises steeply from the origin, curves over, then levels off at a constant plateau.

B.alt: Graph of rate against time: rate starts at zero, rises slowly then more steeply in an S-shape, then levels off at a constant plateau.

C.alt: Graph of rate against time: rate starts at zero, rises to a single peak, then falls to a lower value.

D.alt: Graph of rate against time: rate starts at its maximum value and falls steadily, levelling off at a low value.
